gpt-transcribe.description: OpenAI gpt-transcribe via the /v1/audio/transcriptions file endpoint
gpt-transcribe.pricingNotes: OpenAI lists gpt-transcribe at $0.0045/min, stored as $0.27/hr. The endpoint reports billed audio in whole seconds through usage.seconds. Batch discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/speech-to-text documents a 25 MB upload limit for /v1/audio/transcriptions and accepts mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, wav, and webm. No batch duration cap is published. Verified 2026-09-16: gpt-transcribe rejects response_format verbose_json and srt/vtt, so AutoShow requests response_format json and records a single whole-request segment with no native word timing.
